title: ship.config.json
description: Per-app identity manifest for the shipkit pipeline. One file per repo, at the repo root. Every ship command resolves paths and IDs through here; nothing else may hardcode an app.

name.description: Human-facing app name. Used in output only; the App Store name lives in the staged listing.

bundleId.description: Production iOS bundle identifier. Must match the binary EAS builds and the app RevenueCat is configured against.

version.description: Marketing version override. Omit to read expo.version from app.json, which is the usual case.

appDir.description: Directory containing app.json / eas.json / package.json, relative to the repo root. Repos that nest the Expo app set this (e.g. "mobile").

appId.description: App Store Connect numeric app id. Find it with `asc apps list`. Null until the app exists in ASC.

profile.description: Named `asc auth` credential to use. Null uses the default profile.

primaryLocale.description: Source locale. Shared URLs fall back to this locale's staged listing.

profile.description: eas.json build profile used by `ship build`.

channel.description: EAS Update channel/branch used by `ship ota`.

environment.description: EAS environment whose variables `ship ota` loads before exporting the bundle.

requiredEnv.description: EXPO_PUBLIC_* keys that must be present in the EAS environment and inlined into the bundle before `ship ota` publishes. Keys whose absence crashes the app belong here.

dir.description: Root of the listing tree: staged/ (authored) plus app-info/ and version/<v>/ (generated — never hand-edit).

locales.description: ASC locales this app ships. Informational; the staged directory is the real source.

spec.description: Screenshot design spec, relative to store.dir. Its presence is what turns on `ship shots capture/render/verify`; a repo that only uploads finished PNGs has no such file. See schema/screenshot-spec.schema.json.

projectId.description: RevenueCat v2 project id, e.g. projf0d996da.

appId.description: RevenueCat app id for the App Store app.

entitlement.description: Entitlement lookup_key gating paid features. `ship rc audit` fails when it is missing from the project.

keyEnv.description: Name of the env var holding the public SDK key the app reads at runtime, e.g. EXPO_PUBLIC_RC_IOS_KEY. Name only — never the value.

key.description: Name of the secret-key file under ~/.omp/revenuecat/ (stem, e.g. "car"), or an absolute path. Omit it: `ship rc` tries the ambient ~/.omp/revenuecat.key first and, only if that key cannot see projectId, picks the key in ~/.omp/revenuecat/ that can. Name or path only — never the value.

orgId.description: Apple Ads org id. Credentials are separate from App Store Connect.

dir.description: Where `ship ads plan` writes campaign plans.

targetCpi.description: Target cost per install in USD, and the single source of the kill rule: `ship ads mine` negates a search term only once it is past 2x this AND has enough taps to make zero installs evidence. Must not exceed subPrice x retentionMonths.

subPrice.description: Monthly subscription price in USD, the denominator of the payback rule. Validated against targetCpi at load time.

retentionMonths.description: Months of subscription revenue a paid install is underwritten against. Raise it only if retention data justifies it: it is what makes a targetCpi above one month's price legal.

seedBid.description: Starting bid in USD for keywords with no realised cost-per-tap yet (default 0.60). Deliberately above Apple's 0.30 minimum, which loses every auction. Once the account has spend, `ship ads plan` prefers the realised CPT over this.

baselineInstallRate.description: Tap to install rate a keyword is presumed capable of. Sets the minimum taps before zero installs is treated as evidence: at 0.4 that is 6 taps.

minTaps.description: Override the derived minimum tap count before `ship ads mine` may negate a keyword.

retain.description: How many dated artifacts (mining, snapshot) to keep in ads.dir. Older ones are pruned and every kept one is listed in index.json.

dir.description: Keyword research artifacts, one subdirectory per locale.

seeds.description: Fallback seed terms for autocomplete harvesting, in the source language. Empty derives them from the primary listing's name and subtitle.

seedsByLocale.description: Per-locale seeds in that market's own language, written by `ship loc seed`. Harvesting a non-source storefront with source-language seeds returns translations of your own copy, not what locals type.

minVolume.description: Drop scored terms whose demand estimate falls below this. Low competition with no demand is the default failure mode of supply-side scoring.

sourceLocale.description: Locale the copy is authored in. Null means asc.primaryLocale.

glossary.description: Brand terms, feature names and never-translate strings shared by store copy and in-app strings.

dir.description: Where `ship analytics pull` caches App Store impression/conversion reports.

basePriceUsd.description: US price the territory plan is derived from.

privacyUrl.description: Published privacy policy. `ship preflight` HEAD-requests it — a dead URL is an automatic review rejection.

euTrader.description: EU trader status declared in App Store Connect. Undeclared apps are removed from EU storefronts, so `ship preflight` fails when this is null and any EU locale ships.

dir.description: Where the product brief and the append-only decision log live.

category.description: App Store category slug the research planner ranks competitors within.

audience.description: Who the app is for, in one phrase. Read by the research planner and the design synthesizer; the full target-user description belongs in product/brief.json.

dir.description: Research artifacts, one subdirectory per research run.

providers.description: Evidence providers, in preference order. Only appstore and manual are implemented; the rest are adapter slots against the same normalized reference model.

flows.description: Flow ids to research, from src/lib/flows.mjs. Empty uses the default research set. Research is requested per flow, never per screen.

budget.description: Hard per-run fetch cap. `ship research verify` fails a run that exceeded it, which is what keeps a public, undocumented endpoint being read at the volume one person browsing generates.

screensPerApp.description: The storefront serves at most 10 marketing shots per app.

reviewPages.description: 50 reviews per page, pages 1-10 per sort; page 11 errors.

dir.description: Design system, UX spec and component inventory.

system.description: The token file `ship design system|review` writes and validates. Repo-relative, so it can live inside the app tree instead.

qa.description: The matrix `ship qa` captures every screen across.

url.description: The running RN-Web build `ship qa` drives, e.g. http://localhost:8081. Tier 1 captures nothing without it.

dynamicType.description: Dynamic Type steps. XL is where generated layouts overflow.
